qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D in concerned/allied/relevant discipline, Master's Degree with 55% marks, Master's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with 55% marks
qualification.details: Professor in Sports Management / Management: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engage in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per the criteria of UGC OR An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D Degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made a significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years' experience. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in University/College as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at an equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate. Finance & Accounts Officer (FAO): Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed. At least 15 years of experience as an Assistant Professor in Academic level 11 and above or with 8 years of service in Academic level 12 and above including as an Associate Professor along with experience in Educational Administration OR Comparable experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of Higher Education OR 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post. Librarian: Master's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with at least 55% of marks or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed. At least 10 years as a Librarian at any level in a University Library or Ten years of teaching as an Assistant/Associate Professor in Library Science or ten years' experience as a College Librarian. Evidence of innovative Library services, including the integration of ICT in a Library. A Ph.D degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation/Archives and Manuscript Keeping.

content_sections.heading: SASU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Professor in Sports Management / Management, 1 for Finance & Accounts Officer (FAO), and 1 for Librarian.

content_sections.heading: SASU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Professor in Sports Management / Management: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engage in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per the criteria of UGC OR An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D Degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made a significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years' experience. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in University/College as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at an equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate. Finance & Accounts Officer (FAO): Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed. At least 15 years of experience as an Assistant Professor in Academic level 11 and above or with 8 years of service in Academic level 12 and above including as an Associate Professor along with experience in Educational Administration OR Comparable experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of Higher Education OR 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post. Librarian: Master's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with at least 55% of marks or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed. At least 10 years as a Librarian at any level in a University Library or Ten years of teaching as an Assistant/Associate Professor in Library Science or ten years' experience as a College Librarian. Evidence of innovative Library services, including the integration of ICT in a Library. A Ph.D degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation/Archives and Manuscript Keeping.

content_sections.heading: SASU Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 55 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be as per the government rules and regulations. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the SASU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SASU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the SASU Recruitment 2026 is 21 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the SASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available in the SASU Recruitment 2026 for Professor in Sports Management / Management, Finance & Accounts Officer, and Librarian posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Professor post?
faq.answer: For the Professor post, an eminent scholar with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline and a minimum of 10 years of teaching/research experience is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the posts advertised by SASU?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts advertised by SASU is 55 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 1000. This fee is payable online.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Professor and other posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Professor, Finance & Accounts Officer, and Librarian posts is Rs. 1,44,200 – 2,18,200 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the SASU Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply offline for the SASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, applications for the SASU Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for SASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article or from the official website of Sri Sri Aniruddhadeva Sports University.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of Sri Sri Aniruddhadeva Sports University?
faq.answer: Sri Sri Aniruddhadeva Sports University is located in Dibrugarh, Assam, with the pincode 786003.
